description: I bought a SWAN boiler for 11900 UAH from the SWAN store in Kyiv. NOVA POSHTA delivered it to my local branch on 2025-10-14 in a fully sealed box, so I did not open it at the branch. At home I found several small holes in the box and in the boiler tank that look like shrapnel damage from a missile strike. The boiler is damaged and unsafe to use. I cannot tell whether it happened at the SWAN warehouse, at a NOVA POSHTA terminal or during transport.
